title: An Indoor Paint Shop  (室内的刷漆工坊)

segments.t: 周一持续的细雨敲打着庭院的屋顶，宽敞的后走廊里靠墙立着四扇光秃秃的木制百叶窗。格雷厄姆拿着一卷牛皮纸和一个小风扇，走到汉娜和凯勒布身边。先完整听一遍吧。
Still raining outside, Graham. Will green paint ever dry indoors by Wednesday?
It will if we lay brown paper here and move warm air down the hall.
Water based garden paint: low smell, fast drying if the air keeps moving.
Where do we point the small fan, Caleb?
Crack the courtyard transom two centimeters and blow dry indoor air toward it.
Smart! Steady dry air flows past the wood without letting a drop of rain in.
Look at the color in the tin when I stir it: deep linden leaf green!
Thin even strokes along the grain, Hannah. Thick paint stays sticky.
First coat before lunch, second coat tonight, rock hard by Tuesday afternoon!
Hand me the wide brush, Graham. Shutter number one is mine!
Save a small brush for the corners... and somebody watch the door if Arthur walks by.
Too late. Here comes Arthur in his clean white Monday shirt!
现在，让我们一句一句来回味这段雨天干活的对话。
Still raining outside, Graham. Will green paint ever dry indoors by Wednesday?
「外面还在下雨，格雷厄姆。室内刷的绿漆到周三能干吗？」 开头省略了主语和系动词直接引出天气状况，自然利落，而 by Wednesday 设定了最后期限，
Still raining outside
意思是到周三为止。
It will if we lay brown paper here and move warm air down the hall.
「只要我们在这里铺上牛皮纸，把暖空气引到走廊里，就能干。」 没有简单地回答 yes，而是用助动词 will 笃定地回应了汉娜的疑问，
It will
表现出凯勒布一贯的沉稳。
Water based garden paint: low smell, fast drying if the air keeps moving.
「水性庭院漆：气味小，只要空气保持流通，干得很快。」 为了表达某个动作持续不断，英语常用 keep 加上动词的 -ing 形式，这里
keeps moving
生动地描绘了空气不断流动的状态。
Where do we point the small fan, Caleb?
「我们把小风扇朝向哪里，凯勒布？」 作为表示动作的动词，
point the small fan
指把风扇、灯光或相机等对准某个具体的方向。
Crack the courtyard transom two centimeters and blow dry indoor air toward it.
「把庭院的气窗开个两厘米的缝，把室内干燥的空气往那边吹。」 说到门窗时，动词 crack 可不是打破的意思，而是
Crack the courtyard transom
指微微打开一条缝隙。
Smart! Steady dry air flows past the wood without letting a drop of rain in.
「聪明！持续的干燥空气吹过木头，又不会让一滴雨水飘进来。」 在介词 without 之后，动词需要用 -ing 形式，
without letting
搭配最后的 in，完整表达了“不让……进来”的意思。
Look at the color in the tin when I stir it: deep linden leaf green!
「看看我搅拌时罐子里的颜色：深邃的菩提树叶绿！」 无论是在厨房还是在干活，用棍子或勺子搅动液体都可以用这个词，
when I stir it
而 deep 则加深了这抹绿色的浓郁感。
Thin even strokes along the grain, Hannah. Thick paint stays sticky.
「顺着木纹刷出薄而均匀的笔触，汉娜。漆太厚会一直发粘。」 木匠和漆工们常用的专业说法是
along the grain
指顺着木头自然的纹理方向去刷。
First coat before lunch, second coat tonight, rock hard by Tuesday afternoon!
「午饭前刷第一遍，今晚刷第二遍，到周二下午就能干透坚硬如石！」 这里 coat 指的不是外套，而是刷漆时的“涂层”或“遍数”。英语把“坚硬如石”直接连起来说成
rock hard
形容漆面完全干透后结实的状态。
Hand me the wide brush, Graham. Shutter number one is mine!
「把那把宽刷子递给我，格雷厄姆。一号百叶窗归我了！」 在日常口语里，hand 直接用作动词非常方便，
Hand me
意思就是把某样东西递到别人手里。
Save a small brush for the corners... and somebody watch the door if Arthur walks by.
「留一把小刷子刷角落……还有，要是阿瑟走过，谁来看着点门。」 加上表示经过的介词 by，动词短语
walks by
生动地描绘了某人恰好步行路过门口的情景。
Too late. Here comes Arthur in his clean white Monday shirt!
「太迟了。阿瑟穿着他那件干净的周一白衬衫过来了！」 在人物出场时，把表示位置的词放在句首形成倒装
Here comes Arthur
瞬间烘托出了阿瑟登场时的戏剧感。现在，用自然语速把整个场景再听一遍吧。
Still raining outside, Graham. Will green paint ever dry indoors by Wednesday?
It will if we lay brown paper here and move warm air down the hall.
Water based garden paint: low smell, fast drying if the air keeps moving.
Where do we point the small fan, Caleb?
Crack the courtyard transom two centimeters and blow dry indoor air toward it.
Smart! Steady dry air flows past the wood without letting a drop of rain in.
Look at the color in the tin when I stir it: deep linden leaf green!
Thin even strokes along the grain, Hannah. Thick paint stays sticky.
First coat before lunch, second coat tonight, rock hard by Tuesday afternoon!
Hand me the wide brush, Graham. Shutter number one is mine!
Save a small brush for the corners... and somebody watch the door if Arthur walks by.
Too late. Here comes Arthur in his clean white Monday shirt!
地上铺好了牛皮纸，锅炉房的暖空气缓缓流动，这个雨天周一的刷漆工坊正式开工——就在阿瑟穿着洁白衬衫走来的这一刻！我们下个场景见。
See you soon!
